# What City Are You Quiz Skill

This skill runs a short, fun quiz in chat that matches your answers to a traveller city style. It asks ten original questions one by one, keeps the score hidden, then names one city and one style, with a simple activity to try. It is just for fun, not a personality test, and not personal travel advice.

A general public travel quiz for everyone. No technical skill is needed. You just answer in chat, in plain language, in English or French. Just for fun, not a personality test, not personal travel advice, not a booking, not a price, and not a guaranteed itinerary. For a real trip, check official travel advice and current local conditions. Each result describes a travel mood and a type of activity to try. It never describes the people of a city, and it never makes a claim about a real person.
